```{=html}
<style>
.w021 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w021 .w021-pool {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w021 .w021-buckets { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w021 .w021-bucket {
  flex: 1 1 220px; min-height: 130px; padding: 8px;
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); cursor: pointer;
}
.w021 .w021-bucket.w021-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w021 .w021-btitle { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.w021 .w021-bdesc { text-align: center; font-size: 0.8rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.75; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.w021 .w021-drop { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; min-height: 34px; }
.w021 .w021-chip {
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: grab; user-select: none;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600;
}
.w021 .w021-chip.w021-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w021 .w021-chip.w021-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w021 .w021-chip.w021-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w021 .w021-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w021 button.w021-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w021 .w021-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w021 .w021-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w021 .w021-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w021 iw" id="w021">
  <div class="w021-pool" aria-label="items to classify"></div>
  <div class="w021-buckets">
    <div class="w021-bucket" data-cat="t1">
      <div class="w021-btitle">Type 1</div>
      <div class="w021-bdesc">bare-metal — runs directly<br>on the hardware</div>
      <div class="w021-drop"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="w021-bucket" data-cat="t2">
      <div class="w021-btitle">Type 2</div>
      <div class="w021-bdesc">hosted — an application<br>on a host operating system</div>
      <div class="w021-drop"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="w021-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w021-btn w021-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w021-btn w021-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
  </div>
  <div class="w021-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w021');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w021-pool');
  const buckets = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w021-bucket')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w021-msg');
  const ITEMS = [
    ['VirtualBox', 't2'],
    ['ESXi', 't1'],
    ['beneath a rented cloud VM', 't1'],
    ['VMware Workstation', 't2'],
    ['Xen', 't1'],
    ['beneath the laboratory’s Ubuntu VM', 't2'],
    ['Hyper-V', 't1']
  ];
  let picked = null;

  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w021-picked');
    picked = null;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w021-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w021-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('w021-right', 'w021-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w021-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(bucket, chip) {
    bucket.querySelector('.w021-drop').appendChild(chip);
    clearMarks();
  }
  function makeChip(label, cat, i) {
    const c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'w021-chip';
    c.textContent = label;
    c.dataset.cat = cat;
    c.dataset.id = 'w021i' + i;
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement !== pool) { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); return; }
      if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
      unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w021-picked');
      buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.add('w021-armed'));
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', c.dataset.id));
    return c;
  }
  buckets.forEach(bucket => {
    bucket.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(bucket, picked); unpick(); } });
    bucket.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    bucket.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const chip = root.querySelector('.w021-chip[data-id="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
      if (chip) { place(bucket, chip); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const chip = root.querySelector('.w021-chip[data-id="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
    if (chip) { pool.appendChild(chip); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w021-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, unplaced = 0;
    root.querySelectorAll('.w021-chip').forEach(c => {
      c.classList.remove('w021-right', 'w021-wrong');
      if (c.parentElement === pool) { unplaced++; return; }
      const bucket = c.closest('.w021-bucket');
      if (c.dataset.cat === bucket.dataset.cat) { c.classList.add('w021-right'); right++; }
      else { c.classList.add('w021-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — both hypervisor types sorted.'; msg.className = 'w021-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (unplaced > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + unplaced + ' item(s) still unplaced.'; msg.className = 'w021-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red items are in the wrong box.'; msg.className = 'w021-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w021-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w021-chip').forEach(c => pool.appendChild(c));
    unpick(); clearMarks();
  });
  ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => pool.appendChild(makeChip(it[0], it[1], i)));
})();
</script>
```
